Uttar Pradesh CM Announces 25% Discount on Khadi Garments

Uttar Pradesh Chief Minister Yogi Adityanath announced a 25% discount on Khadi garments, which will be effective until January 30, 2027. The announcement was made in connection with Gandhi Jayanti and Shastri Jayanti, with the Chief Minister visiting the Hazratganj Khadi Ashram and purchasing a saffron-colored gamcha. He encouraged people to make Khadi a part of their lives.
